summaryDetail: The top priority is the global marketing strategy focused on Asia Star and Intelligent China, with conversion tracking and participant profile analysis underway to boost SEO and attract overseas executives. This week, the team must resolve Outlook password sync issues across devices and contact JSB to confirm backend unlock, while Joseph shares the knowledge website design HTML and the team meets to provide feedback before Joker implements changes. Looking ahead, key deadlines include Joseph's draft of target areas, the conversion tracking brief, and the Americas website estimate, alongside creative tasks like the CKGSB Monthly motion graphic and the '48 hours inside Asia Start' video feasibility check. The knowledge website redesign is progressing with decisions to remove the videos panel, disperse videos by topic, and incorporate BCI/BSI indices and more articles on the homepage.
